name: mafia
description: Party games to play with friends online: Mafia (4-8 players), Pen Fight (2-5), Pictionary (4-12) and Badminton (2-4).

scripts.build: node build.js && node penfight/build.js && node pictionary/build.js && node badminton/build.js
scripts.test: node test/engine.test.js && node penfight/test/game.test.js && node pictionary/test/game.test.js && node badminton/test/game.test.js
